title: Treatments & Therapies
intro: Classical therapies, prepared and administered the way they have been here for generations.

items.name: Panchakarma
items.note: The classical five-fold purification. A staged programme of preparation, elimination and rebuilding, prescribed only after assessment and carried out under supervision over several days.

items.name: Abhyanga
items.note: Warm medicated oil worked over the whole body in long strokes. Used both on its own and as preparation before deeper therapies.

items.name: Pizhichil
items.note: A continuous stream of warm medicated oil poured over the body while it is massaged. Traditionally used for stiffness, pain and depletion.

items.name: Njavarakizhi
items.note: Boluses of njavara rice cooked in milk and herbal decoction, applied warm. Nourishing rather than reducing — often used in recovery and in the elderly.

items.name: Shirodhara
items.note: A steady stream of warm oil or decoction poured across the forehead. Widely used for sleep, anxiety and mental fatigue.

items.name: Kizhi
items.note: Warm poultices of herbs, powders or rice applied in rhythm over the body or a specific area.

items.name: Herbal medicines
items.note: Internal preparations dispensed from our own kitchen — decoctions, powders, medicated ghee and oils, prepared to classical method.

items.name: Yoga Therapy
items.note: Postures and breathing prescribed for the individual, including modified sequences for pregnancy and the postpartum months.

items.name: Meditation
items.note: Guided practice used alongside psychological care for stress, sleep and emotional regulation.

items.name: Diet therapy
items.note: Food as treatment: what to eat, when, and in what state — matched to constitution, season and stage of life.

items.name: Udvarthanam
items.note: Dry or semi-dry herbal powder massage worked against the direction of hair growth. Used in weight management and hormonal conditions.

items.name: Nethradhara
items.note: A gentle wash of medicated liquid over the eyes, for strain, dryness and irritation.

items.name: Steam bath
items.note: Medicated steam, usually following oil application, to open the channels and prepare for elimination.

items.name: Lifestyle modification
items.note: Daily and seasonal routine — dinacharya and ritucharya — worked out with you rather than handed to you.

note: DUMMY CONTENT — the description on each therapy is drafted for clinician review, not taken from the source document. Have a doctor approve or rewrite each one before launch.
